sentences.text: If you dig a hole and fill it with water, you have a pool.
But the water soaks into the ground, and all 20,000 gallons drain away.
So you spray a concrete shell on the floor and walls, and the water stays.
But now leaves fall in, and the still water turns green.
So you add a pump, a pipe, and a tank of sand.
The pump pulls water from the floor, sand traps the dirt, and clean water returns every eight hours.
And the strong chlorine smell is not a sign of a clean pool.
It is chlorine stuck to sweat and oils, so a truly clean pool barely smells.
Add a fence, bushes and young trees to keep it safe.
Congratulations, you have built a swimming pool.
